page_title: Privacy Policy — AI Business Studio London
heading: Privacy Policy
body:
We operate under strict confidentiality. This policy dictates the operational parameters governing how we collect, process, and secure your data.

We require specific professional intelligence (name, business email, organization, and operational context) during the application process. This data is gathered exclusively to assess structural alignment before an engagement is authorized.

Your information is processed internally as confidential business intelligence. We unconditionally reject the distribution, leasing, or sharing of applicant data with external third parties.

All submissions are governed by strict technological safeguards. We maintain absolute compliance with mandated data protection protocols to ensure absolute structural security over your operational information.
